briefdescription.para: Returns how much of the incoming argument stack area (in bytes) we should clean up in an epilogue.

detaileddescription.para: For the C calling convention this will be 0, for guaranteed tail call conventions it can be positive (a normal return or a tail call to a function that uses less stack space for arguments) or negative (for a tail call to a function that needs more stack space than us for arguments).
